summary: Batman: Arkham franchise entries added as supplemental sourced guide rows; Sami did not list these in the locked personal spine.

entries.title: Batman: Arkham Asylum
entries.definitive_edition: Game of the Year Edition on Windows

primary.why: Batman: Arkham Asylum released on PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Windows, later received Mac, Return to Arkham console remasters, and a Switch trilogy release. Windows Game of the Year Edition is the best archive route because it has the complete challenge-map package, the highest PC display/capture ceiling, and well-known community fixes.
primary.how_to_play: Use Batman: Arkham Asylum Game of the Year Edition on Windows, applying community compatibility fixes if needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Return to Arkham changes presentation and is console-only; keep it as comparison, not the main PC archive route.

entries.title: Batman: Arkham City Lockdown

primary.why: Arkham City Lockdown released first on iOS and later on Android as a mobile fighting spin-off. The original iOS release is the cleanest archival target because it was the first supported release and no platform-exclusive content is sourced for Android.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legitimately retained iOS install on compatible legacy hardware if available; otherwise preserve captures and metadata.

entries.remaster_caveats: Legacy mobile spin-off; current storefront availability is unreliable.

entries.title: Batman: Arkham City
entries.definitive_edition: Game of the Year Edition on Windows plus Wii U Armored Edition secondary

emulation.notes: Native Windows for main route; Wii U hardware/emulation only for Armored Edition features.

primary.why: Arkham City released on PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Windows, Wii U, OS X, Return to Arkham console remasters, and Switch. Windows Game of the Year Edition is the best main run because it has the complete DLC package and the highest capture/display ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use Batman: Arkham City Game of the Year Edition on Windows. Use the Wii U Armored Edition only for its platform-specific mechanics.

secondary.exclusive_content: Wii U GamePad-driven mechanics and Armored Edition feature set
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the Armored Edition-specific mechanics and features; do not replay the full story unless desired.
secondary.why: The Wii U release is documented as adding gameplay mechanics and features made for the Wii U controller, while Windows GOTY remains the fidelity/complete-content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Return to Arkham changes presentation and is console-only; Wii U mechanics are secondary-only.

entries.title: Batman: Arkham Origins

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC where available
primary.why: Arkham Origins released on PlayStation 3, Wii U, Windows, and Xbox 360. Windows is the best archive route because it has the strongest capture/display ceiling and PC compatibility-fix path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows release with single-player DLC installed where owned. Treat the separate mobile game and Blackgate as their own entries.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate the console/PC game with the separate Arkham Origins mobile fighting game.

entries.title: Batman: Arkham Origins (mobile)

primary.why: Arkham Origins mobile is a distinct iOS and Android fighting game, separate from the console/PC Arkham Origins. It released first on iOS, then Android, and has no sourced platform-exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legitimately retained iOS install on compatible legacy hardware if available; otherwise preserve captures and metadata.

entries.remaster_caveats: As of now, the game is no longer available for normal download; preserve legacy installs/captures.

entries.title: Batman: Arkham Origins Blackgate

primary.why: Arkham Origins Blackgate launched on Nintendo 3DS and PlayStation Vita, then received a Deluxe Edition for Windows, PlayStation 3, Wii U, and Xbox 360. Windows Deluxe Edition is the best archive route because it has the upgraded home-platform release with the highest capture/display ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use Batman: Arkham Origins Blackgate - Deluxe Edition on Windows.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original handheld versions are historical comparison targets.

entries.title: Batman: Arkham Knight

emulation.notes: Native Windows, with settings/fixes available for modern systems.

primary.why: Arkham Knight released on PlayStation 4, Windows, and Xbox One, then came to Switch through Arkham Trilogy. The current Windows release is the best archive route because it has the highest capture/display ceiling and the complete DLC path, despite the historically troubled PC launch.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows release with DLC installed and community fixes/settings as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: PC launch was troubled; archive the current patched state, not launch-state performance.

entries.title: Batman: Arkham Underworld

emulation.notes: Legacy mobile preservation only; service state prevents a normal recommendation.

primary.why: Arkham Underworld was a mobile strategy spin-off for iOS and Android, but the service was removed from normal storefront play. The original iOS release is the archival reference route because it was the first mobile release and no stable modern play route is sourced.
primary.how_to_play: No normal current play route is sourced; preserve legacy installed builds, video captures, and metadata where available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Discontinued mobile service; no current official offline edition is sourced.

entries.title: Batman: Arkham VR

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: High-end PC VR headset on Windows

primary.why: Arkham VR released first for PlayStation VR and later for Windows VR headsets. Windows VR is the best archive route because it has the broader headset/GPU/capture ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows Steam release with a supported PC VR headset.

entries.remaster_caveats: Short VR spin-off; it is not a replacement for the main action-adventure games.

entries.title: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League

primary.why: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League is a Rocksteady-developed spin-off/follow-up in the Batman: Arkham universe, released on PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows is the best archive route because it has the highest capture/settings ceiling for the current build.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows release through Steam or Epic. Verify current service/offline-mode status and seasonal content availability before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service/post-launch content availability should be verified at time of capture.

entries.title: Batman: Arkham Shadow

primary.why: Batman: Arkham Shadow is a full-length VR entry available only on Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest 3S. Meta Quest 3 is the best archive route because it has the higher hardware/display ceiling between the standalone headset options.
primary.how_to_play: Use Batman: Arkham Shadow on Meta Quest 3. Use Quest 3S only when that hardware is the available route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Standalone VR-only prequel set between Arkham Origins and Arkham Asylum.
